services.label: Services
title: Pricing
& timing

items.title: Template website
items.text: Pick one of the 5 templates above. I replace the photos and texts with yours — the site looks just the same, with every animation, only with your content.

items.title: Custom landing page
items.text: A one-page website built from scratch: your own design and effects, made for your goal and your style.

items.title: Multi-page website
items.text: The first page is €300, each next page from €150 depending on complexity. One consistent style and clear navigation.

services.note: A custom site starts with a conversation — no call needed. Message me on WhatsApp, Instagram or Telegram, tell me what you want, and we'll work out the details.
services.after: What you get after launch and what support costs

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We talk however suits you — messages or a call. We go through the goal and examples you like.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: I build the style, structure and first screen. We refine it until you say “wow”.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: Layout, animations, mobile. You get a live link and watch it come together.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: I check speed and mobile, connect your domain and publish the site.

faq.label: After launch
title: Your site is live
What's next?
faq.lead: The site is fully yours: it runs on your domain, and you can change texts, prices and photos yourself. Or leave it to me — whatever suits you.

plans.title: Do it yourself
plans.text: Open the admin panel in your browser, change texts, prices and photos, hit “Save” — it's live in 1–2 minutes.

plans.title: One-off edit
plans.text: Tell me what to change and I'll do it. Swapping a photo or a price is €20; a new section is quoted separately.

plans.title: Care plan
plans.text: Up to 5 edits a month (texts, photos, prices), reply within 48 hours, I keep an eye on the site and remind you to renew the domain.

plans.title: Site management
plans.text: I'm at your service during working hours: any edits and tasks on your site — new sections, promotions, seasonal updates, connecting services. Scope and price agreed together.

items.q: What do I get after launch?
items.a: A working website on your domain, access to the admin panel and a short guide: where the domain is registered, where the site is hosted, how to make changes and how to reach me. The site and the domain belong to you.

items.q: Can I edit texts and photos myself?
items.a: Yes. The admin panel opens in your browser like any website: change a text or a price, upload a new photo and save. No code needed, and the design and animations are protected — you can't break them from the admin panel. I invite you by email, no extra accounts to set up.

items.q: What if I don't want to manage the site myself?
items.a: Then just message me. One-off edits start at €20. The care plan is €49 a month: up to 5 small edits (texts, photos, prices), reply within 48 hours. More and bigger tasks? Site management starts at €150 a month, scope agreed individually. Plans can be cancelled any time.

items.q: How much do hosting and the domain cost?
items.a: Hosting for sites like these is free (Cloudflare). You only pay the registrar for the domain — usually €10–20 a year. I'll help you choose, buy and connect it, registered in your name.
Two rounds of revisions on the finished site are included. Anything beyond that is billed as a one-off edit.
A template site takes a few days once I have your texts and photos. A custom landing page takes about a week; multi-page sites are agreed individually.

items.q: What do you need from me?
items.a: Texts, photos, your logo (if you have one) and examples of sites you like. No texts yet? I'll tell you what to write.
50% before I start and 50% before the site goes live on your domain.

items.q: Can you add forms, newsletters and automation?
items.a: Yes: lead forms, subscriber lists, newsletters, automatic emails to customers after a purchase or an enquiry. Quoted separately — tell me what you need.
